records.source: How cells become gene profiles: lof (1 drops the 1% intensity outliers), impute ('median' or 'knn'), pca ('c0' per-well standardised, or 'brieflow'), agg ('guide' = median of guide medians, 'gene' = median of all cells, or 'gene_trim' = their 10% trimmed mean), nt ('pseudo' = four control guides per pseudo-gene, or 'barcode') and tvn ('spacr', or 'brieflow' = Brieflow's control axes). The Hybrid profile is lof 1, knn, brieflow, gene, barcode, brieflow with whitening epsilon 0. Empty is lof 0, median, c0, guide, pseudo, spacr. Default None. Alpha.
records.translation: Hur celler blir genprofiler: lof (1 tar bort de 1% intensitetsavvikarna), impute ('median' eller 'knn'), pca ('c0' standardiserad per brunn, eller 'brieflow'), agg ('guide' = median av guidemedianer, 'gene' = median av alla celler, eller 'gene_trim' = deras 10% trimmade medelvärde), nt ('pseudo' = fyra kontrollguider per pseudogen, eller 'barcode') och tvn ('spacr', eller 'brieflow' = Brieflows kontrollaxlar). Hybrid-profilen är lof 1, knn, brieflow, gene, barcode, brieflow med vitningsepsilon 0. Tomt är lof 0, median, c0, guide, pseudo, spacr. Standard None. Alfa.
